reviews.title: Payment Deducted but Premium Subscription Not Activated
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a premium subscription for the CarDash app through my iPhone. An amount has been deducted from my account, but my subscription has still not been activated, and the app continues to display the message "Payment couldn't be confirmed."
I have tried restoring/confirming the purchase multiple times, but the issue persists. Despite the successful payment deduction, I am unable to access any of the premium features.
This is quite disappointing, as I have already been charged for a service that I cannot use.
I request you to kindly:
1) Verify my payment transaction.
2. Activate my premium subscription immediately.
3. If activation is not possible, initiate a full refund.

Please look into this issue on priority and provide a resolution at the earliest.
I can share the payment receipt or transaction details if required.
